description.zh: 中国成年人参考人群数据：GB/T 10000-1988 百分位（二手转载）、2020 年国民体质监测均值、NCD-RisC 等。GB/T 10000-2023 的表格未能取得。条目内的出处说明为英文。
description.en: Chinese adult reference data: GB/T 10000-1988 percentiles (secondary reprint), 2020 national fitness surveillance means, NCD-RisC and others. The GB/T 10000-2023 tables could not be obtained. Row-level provenance notes are in English.

sources.title: GB/T 10000-2023 中国成年人人体尺寸 (Human dimensions of Chinese adults)
sources.publisher: 国家市场监督管理总局 / 国家标准化管理委员会 (drafted by 中国标准化研究院 CNIS; SAC/TC 7)
sources.licenceOrStatus: Copyrighted national standard. Official platform footer: '版权所有 侵权必究'. Free official online reading ('在线预览', 42 pages) and a '下载标准' button exist on the platform; no open licence is stated. Numeric values may be cited as facts with attribution; the tables/text must not be redistributed.
sources.reliability: primary (metadata, foreword and scope only). The percentile tables were NOT read: the official reader renders the table pages blank to automated browsing (anti-copy measure) and this was not circumvented.

sources.title: T/CEA/TR 0015—2024 担架电梯技术报告 (section 4.1 quotes GB/T 10000-1988 and GB/T 10000-2023 stature percentiles)
sources.licenceOrStatus: Association technical report, publicly downloadable; no open licence stated.
sources.reliability: secondary quotation of the standard; one value only

sources.title: 《人体工学及产品设计实例》 2.2 人体尺寸的基本知识, 表2-4～表2-7 (reprint of GB/T 10000-1988 tables)
sources.publisher: 孙丽丽, 宋魁彦 主编 (textbook; chapter readable online at chuangshi.qq.com)
sources.licenceOrStatus: Copyrighted textbook reprinting values of the copyrighted standard GB/T 10000-1988 (superseded by GB/T 10000-2023). Values citable as facts with attribution to the standard.
sources.reliability: secondary reprint (table images read by eye). Contains visible typesetting errors (age header '男(16~60岁)' for 18~60; female 小腿长 P90 printed as 307). Cross-check against the standard before relying on single cells.

sources.title: 成年人体尺寸数据 (course hand-out giving P5/P50/P95 for 19 dimensions, men upper row / women lower row)
sources.publisher: unknown (course material hosted on aliyun OSS)
sources.reliability: low: several values disagree with the textbook reprint (e.g. eye height, shoulder height, shoulder breadth P95 = P50). Not used for the percentiles array.

sources.title: 第五次国民体质监测公报 (2020), 表2 成年人 / 表3 老年人 各项体质指标平均数
sources.publisher: 国家国民体质监测中心 / 国家体育总局 (republished on 中国政府网)
sources.licenceOrStatus: Official government bulletin, publicly published; site footer '版权所有：中国政府网'. No open licence stated; means are citable facts with attribution.
sources.reliability: primary (official bulletin; tables are images, read by eye). Means only, no SD and no per-cell n. Sample: 121928 adults 20-59, 39973 elderly 60-79.

sources.title: 《中国居民营养与慢性病状况报告(2020年)》 国新办发布会报道
sources.publisher: 国家卫生健康委员会 (reported by 中国新闻网)
sources.licenceOrStatus: News report of an official report; no open licence.
sources.reliability: secondary (news report quoting the official press conference); the full report itself was not opened

sources.title: 2014年国民体质监测公报 — 20-24岁全国平均身高 (quoted in a regional news item)
sources.publisher: 国家体育总局 (quoted by 新浪体育)
sources.reliability: secondary (news quotation); the 2014 bulletin tables were not opened

sources.title: 第八次全国学生体质与健康调研 (2019) 结果发布
sources.publisher: 教育部体育卫生与艺术教育司 (reported by 中国新闻网)
sources.licenceOrStatus: News report of a ministry release; no open licence.
sources.reliability: secondary; gives only 2014->2019 increments for the 19-22 group, not the absolute national means

sources.title: NCD-RisC adult height at age 18 by country, sex and birth cohort 1896-1996 (A century of trends in adult human height, eLife 2016;5:e13410)
sources.licenceOrStatus: Download page carries no licence text, only '© Copyright 2026 NCD Risk Factor Collaboration. All Rights Reserved.' The eLife source article is believed to be CC BY but its licence statement was not opened in this session.

sources.title: NCD-RisC height of children and adolescents 5-19 by country, sex, year 1985-2019 (Lancet 2020;396:1511-24)
sources.licenceOrStatus: Same site statement as above; the source article's licence was not opened in this session.
sources.reliability: primary (modelled estimates); age 19 is the closest proxy for current young-adult height

sources.title: NCD-RisC age-standardised mean BMI of adults by country, sex, year 1975-2016 (Lancet 2017;390:2627-42)
sources.licenceOrStatus: Source article (PMC5735219): '© 2017 The Author(s). Published by Elsevier Ltd. This is an Open Access article under the CC BY 4.0 license'. The download page itself carries no licence text.
sources.reliability: primary (modelled estimates). Latest NCD-RisC release that contains MEAN BMI; the 2024 and 2026 releases contain prevalence by BMI band only.

sources.title: NCD-RisC adult BMI-band prevalences by country, sex, year 1980-2024 (Nature 2026)
sources.licenceOrStatus: No licence text on the download page; source article licence not opened.
sources.reliability: primary (modelled estimates); prevalences only, no mean BMI

sources.title: National Anthropometric Surveys in China (Asian Workshop on 3D Body Scanning Technologies 2012)
sources.publisher: Liu T, Chao C, Zhao C (CNIS); Zhao R
sources.licenceOrStatus: Conference paper, freely downloadable; no open licence stated.
sources.reliability: primary description of the CNIS surveys (no adult percentile values)

sources.title: GB/T 2428 成年人头面部尺寸
GB/T 16252-2023 成年人手部尺寸分型
GB/T 26158-2010 中国未成年人人体尺寸

notes: GB/T 10000-2023 percentile tables (表1-表10, 附录B, 附录C) were NOT obtained. Only one 2023 value was seen on an opened page (male stature P95 = 1800 mm, 18-70, via a secondary quotation). All other entries in 'percentiles' are GB/T 10000-1988 values from a textbook reprint and describe the 1986-87 survey population (men 18-60, women 18-55), not today's population.

Facts about GB/T 10000-2023 confirmed from opened pages (official info page, foreword text as reproduced on standards-listing sites): issued 2023-08-06, in force 2024-03-01; replaces GB/T 10000-1988 and GB/T 13547-1992; based on the 2014-2018 national adult anthropometric survey; 52 static dimensions and 16 functional dimensions; age groups 18-25, 26-35, 36-60, 61-70 plus pooled 18-70; men in 表1-表5, women in 表6-表10; adds 上臂围, 大腿围, 瞳孔间距, 掌围, 足围; 附录C gives mean and SD of stature and body mass for six regions.
The 1988 standard as reprinted has no thigh, upper-arm or neck circumference and no hand or foot length in the tables read here; 上臂围 and 大腿围 are new in the 2023 edition.
The reprint source contains visible errors; the 1988 values here were read by eye from table images. Treat single cells as unverified until checked against the standard.
Units: percentiles are in mm (kg for body mass). Means keep the published units (cm, kg, %, kg/m2); multiply cm by 10 for mm.
National physical fitness surveillance means are for ages 20-79 only; ages 7-19 and students are covered by the Ministry of Education student survey. The bulletin publishes means without SD.

2019 student survey (19-22 years): only the 2014->2019 increments were found on an opened page (men +0.81 cm stature, +2.86 kg, +1.54 cm chest girth; women +0.62 cm, +1.67 kg, +0.83 cm). Absolute national means for 19-22-year-olds were not found.
Chinese BMI cut-offs used by the fitness bulletin (note 8, opened): <18.5 低体重, 18.5-<24.0 正常, 24.0-<28.0 超重, >=28.0 肥胖.

NCD-RisC values are modelled estimates. The China age-19 estimate for 2019 (men 175.7 cm, women 163.5 cm) is several cm above the measured 20-24 means in the 2020 fitness bulletin (172.6 / 160.6 cm); do not mix the two series.
